title: 23 第23章 不入幽冥食鬼神君24 第24章 白衣剑客钱晨
slug: 明尊第九十六章西方颢天沧海横流

第23章不入幽冥，食鬼神君
康千灯想到了儿时贪恋惊鸿剑，常常偷去剑阁，轻弹剑音以悦耳。
不禁学起钱晨，从腰间抽出惊鸿剑，弹剑而歌道：“我观古昔之英雄，慷慨然诺杯酒中。义重生轻死知己，所以与人成大功。我观今日之诸位，意气在面愧在胸。英雄壮志血未寒，刀未加身心已惧……”
“诸位……请一战罢！”康千灯弹剑而起，剑音清脆悦耳，振奋醒了在场所有人。
洪四海也抬头向外望去，那五湖厅前影影绰绰，楼阁前，在正门的牌坊下，几个身影悄然无息的站在了那里。
站在最中心的一位，身材异常高大，他魁梧的身形仿若一只直立而起的猛虎，在月光之下，身影模糊仿若鬼魅，只有脸上噬鬼神虎的面具，赫然清晰，摄人心魄。
在他身边是一个瘦小的影子，披着一条金色的披风，带着一只金鸡面具，惊悚怪异。
最后是一个痴肥的大胖子，他带着一个贪婪的猪相面具，十分凶恶。
“不入幽冥，食鬼神君！”
“天下大白，司晨神君！”
“张口吞天，大肚神君！”
洪四海声音低沉，神情凝重，双拳垂在身体两侧，声音在黑暗中回荡如同滚滚闷雷：“十二元辰，就来了你们几个吗？”
“他们自然都在……”司晨神君的尖利嗓音，叫人从心底感到烦躁，如同破铜锣一样敲响道：“他们在天上，在地下，在幽冥深处做鬼，甚至可能就在你身边。”
“不知什么时候，来取走你这条性命！”
空明禅师闻言，不禁担忧的瞥了一眼自己身后，这才发现，不知什么时候，那位药王传人已经来到了自己身边，平静的注视着场中的一切，康千灯这位他非常欣赏的江湖新秀亦步亦趋的跟在那位药王传人身后……像个…呃…小跟班？
食鬼神君自身后抽出右手，其上带着一个虎头拳套，虎形狰狞，如欲噬人。
他将右拳一横，一股无形的凄厉尖啸瞬间撕裂空气，向四面八方袭去……无数影影绰绰的鬼影此起彼伏，在食鬼神君身边穿梭，诡秘的如同恶鬼一般。
“绝世神兵……大宗师！”
洪四海面色越发肃然，空明禅师脸色凝重，整个五湖厅弥漫着一股沉重的气息，叫人喘不过气来。这位幽冥宫主，食鬼神君，赫然已经达到与洪四海相同的大宗师境界，就连武当顽石道长，少林空明神僧也要稍逊一筹。
他手上的那只虎头拳套，只是微微发出厉啸，就已经让五湖厅中八成的武者恨不得双手抱头，发泄痛苦。

这等威力，已经达到了传说中绝世神兵的等级。
乃是江湖近五十年来，新近降世的第一件绝世神兵……并且就佩戴在初任兵主手中。
神兵——风神啸！
随着食鬼神君渐渐收敛真气，围绕在他身边的风呼啸的更加剧烈了。天地间一股茫茫的风气，自九天之上浩浩荡荡而来，与幽冥宫主、食鬼神君的气势融汇在一起，宛如天龙垂尾，天上的云卷动为一个巨大的漩涡，从天上探入地面。
呼啸的龙卷风刺入了五湖厅和四海堂正门之间的地面。
食鬼神君身边无数影影绰绰的鬼影乘风飞起，化为一道道黑影卷入风中，大风朝着五湖堂中前的群雄袭来，一时间大多数人都被那烈风吹得睁不开眼睛。
这时候，风中的寒光一闪。
一位躲在后头的武林人士的头颅突然掉了下来，滴溜溜的在地上滚动。
接着是第二个，第三个……
人头在地上被风吹得乱滚，在群雄的脚边咕噜咕噜的滚过，销魂风中，百鬼夜行。幽冥宫中的群鬼赫然借着幽冥宫主掀起的龙卷狂风，融入了风中，在龙卷风里穿插飞掠，带走一个个人头。
终于有人承受不住这种压力，一位颇有名气的高手，又哭又笑：“头掉了！我们的头掉了！有鬼……有鬼啊！”
他大喊一声，转头就逃……他的身影背着风逃出去好远，很多人看着他渐行渐远，终于忍不住内心的恐惧，悄悄的跟了上去。
就在那个身影远去只剩下一点背影的时候，他的头掉了下来，骨碌碌的滚远了！

Chapter 23: Not entering the netherworld, eating ghosts and gods
Kang Qiandeng thought of his childhood love for the Jinghong Sword, and how he often stole it from the sword pavilion and played the sword to please his ears.
He couldn't help but imitate Qian Chen, pulled out the Jinghong Sword from his waist, flicked the sword and sang: "I look at the heroes of the past, generously offering a glass of wine. The rebirth of righteousness neglected the death of a close friend, so he achieved great success with others. I look at all of you today, and I am ashamed of my spirit. The blood of the hero's ambition is not cold, and the body and mind are already frightened before the sword is applied..."
"Everyone...please finish the fight!" Kang Qiandeng raised his sword, and the sound of the sword was clear and sweet, inspiring everyone present.
Hong Sihai also raised his head and looked out. In front of the Five Lakes Hall, there were shadowy figures. In front of the pavilion, under the archway of the main entrance, several figures stood there quietly.
The one standing in the center is unusually tall. His burly figure is like an upright tiger. Under the moonlight, his figure is blurry and ghostly. Only the ghost-eating tiger mask on his face is clear and breathtaking.
Next to him is a thin shadow, wearing a golden cloak and a golden rooster mask, which is scary and weird.
Finally, there is a fat man with a greedy pig-like mask, who is very vicious.
"Don't enter the netherworld, the ghost-eating god!"
"The world is clear, Lord Si Chen!"
"Open your mouth to swallow the sky, the big-bellied god!"
Hong Sihai's voice was low and his expression was solemn. His fists hung at his sides. His voice echoed in the darkness like rolling thunder: "Twelve Yuan Chen, are you the only ones here?"
"Of course they are all here..." Divine Lord Si Chen's sharp voice made people feel irritated from the bottom of their hearts. He sounded like a broken gong: "They are in the sky, underground, working as ghosts in the depths of the netherworld, and they may even be right next to you."
"I don't know when I will come and take your life!"
Hearing this, Zen Master Kongming couldn't help but cast a worried glance behind him, only to realize that at some point, the descendant of the King of Medicine had already arrived beside him, calmly watching everything in the field. Kang Qiandeng, a rising star in the world that he admired very much, followed step by step behind the successor of the King of Medicine... like... uh... a little follower?
The Ghost-Eating God took out his right hand after himself, with a tiger-head gauntlet on it. The tiger was in the shape of a ferocious tiger, as if it wanted to bite people.
He swung his right fist, and an invisible shrill scream instantly tore through the air and struck in all directions... Countless shadowy ghosts appeared one after another, shuttling around the Ghost-Eating Lord, mysteriously like evil ghosts.
"Peerless divine weapon... Grand master!"
Hong Sihai's expression became more and more solemn, Zen Master Kongming's expression became solemn, and the entire Five Lakes Hall was filled with a heavy atmosphere that made people breathless. This Netherworld Palace Master, the Ghost-eating God Lord, has surprisingly reached the same level of Grand Master as Hong Sihai. Even Wudang Nushi Taoist and Shaolin Kongming Divine Monk are slightly behind.
The tiger-headed glove in his hand just let out a slight roar, which already made 80% of the warriors in the Wuhu Hall want to hold their heads in their hands and vent their pain.
This kind of power has reached the level of the legendary peerless magic weapon.
It is the first peerless magic weapon that has recently come to the world in the past fifty years... and it is worn in the hands of the first weapon master.
Divine Weapon——Feng Shen Xiao!
As the Ghost-eating God gradually gathered his energy, the wind around him roared more violently. A vast wind between heaven and earth came from the nine heavens, and merged with the momentum of the Netherworld Palace Master and the Ghost-Eating God Lord. Like the hanging tail of a heavenly dragon, the clouds in the sky rolled into a huge whirlpool, penetrating from the sky into the ground.
The roaring tornado pierced the ground between the Wuhu Hall and the main entrance of the Sihai Hall.
Countless shadowy ghost figures around the Ghost-eating Lord flew up in the wind, turning into black shadows and being swept into the wind. The strong wind hit the heroes in front of the Five Lakes Hall. For a while, most people were blinded by the strong wind.
At this time, a cold light flashed in the wind.
The head of a martial artist hiding behind suddenlyIt fell down and rolled on the ground.
Then the second, the third...
Human heads were blown wildly on the ground by the wind, and rolled gurglingly at the feet of the heroes. In the ecstasy wind, hundreds of ghosts walked at night. The ghosts in the Nether Palace suddenly merged into the wind with the help of the tornado set off by the Lord of the Nether Palace, flying through the tornado and taking away a person's head.
Finally, someone couldn't bear the pressure. A well-known expert cried and laughed: "Heads have fallen off! Our heads have fallen off! There is a ghost... there is a ghost!"
He yelled, turned around and ran away... His figure escaped a long way away with the wind behind him. Many people watched him drifting away, and finally couldn't help the fear in their hearts and followed him quietly.
Just when the figure disappeared and only a trace of his back was left, his head fell off and rolled away!
